calculation.description: Ranks assets nearer their lagged 60-day high more positively, normalized by lagged 20-day realized volatility; all inputs lagged one completed day.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in 2026-27 (+0.064421), approximately flat in 2028-29 (+0.000928), positive in 2030-32 (+0.061446) and 2033-34 (+0.045994). Sign is the inverse of the tested drawdown signal, whose IC was -0.043825. Small 15-asset cross-section; uncertainty interpreted across 2,071 dates.
